# webbpulse_registry_provider (Data Source)

One private provider in the registry with every version published or attempted, newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "webbpulse_registry_provider" "webbpulse" {
  namespace = "WebbPulse"
  type      = "webbpulse"
}

output "provider_versions" {
  value = data.webbpulse_registry_provider.webbpulse.published_versions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) The namespace, which is the repository owner.
- `type` (String) The provider type.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the provider was connected, or null.
- `id` (String) The provider address, `namespace/type`.
- `published_versions` (List of String) Every published version, newest first.
- `source` (String) The address a `required_providers` source names after the registry host.
- `vcs_repo` (String) The connected repository as `owner/name`.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Every version published or attempted, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `error` (String) Why publishing failed, or null.
- `key_id` (String) The GPG key id the checksums are signed with, or null.
- `platforms` (Attributes List) Every os and architecture the version ships for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions--platforms))
- `protocols` (List of String) The plugin protocol versions the version speaks, such as `6.0`.
- `published_at` (String) When the version published, or null while it is pending or after it failed.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `published` or `failed`.
- `tag` (String) The git tag the version came from.
- `version` (String) The semantic version.

<a id="nestedatt--versions--platforms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions.platforms`

Read-Only:

- `arch` (String) The architecture, such as `amd64`.
- `filename` (String) The zip archive's file name.
- `os` (String) The operating system, such as `linux`.
- `shasum` (String) The zip archive's SHA-256.
